title: Selbstzeugnisse der Frühen Neuzeit in der Herzog August Bibliothek: Diarium Herzog Augusts des Jüngeren and Tagebücher Ludwig Rudolphs und Christine Luises
notes: Portal of the HAB with a register of manuscript self-testimonies in the library, the edition of the diary (Ephemerides sive Diarium) of Duke August the Younger of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel for 1594-1635 (1,656 dated entries), the edition of four diaries of Duke Ludwig Rudolph and Duchess Christine Luise (1698-1724) and, since 2022, the 'Grand Tour digital' project (separate entry in the catalogue). TEI P5 files are available for download (the diary as one XML file, the 1698-1724 diaries as sz2.zip, both in the HAB GitLab). Counts are ours, from the TEI: about 50,300 words in the 1594-1635 diary and about 17,650 in Christine Luise's diary of 1698/99, leaving out editorial notes and indexes; Ludwig Rudolph's diaries (1701, 1707, 1712-13, 1724) are after the period and are not counted. The data are under CC BY-SA 4.0 unless stated otherwise.
